operation.description:
Sets the GitHub Actions permissions policy for enabling GitHub Actions and allowed actions and reusable workflows in the repository.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: Set GitHub Actions permissions for a repository

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/schemas/actions-enabled.description: Whether GitHub Actions is enabled on the repository.

#/components/schemas/allowed-actions.description: The permissions policy that controls the actions and reusable workflows that are allowed to run.

#/components/schemas/sha-pinning-require.description: Whether actions must be pinned to a full-length commit SHA.
